insights.insight: Crinkl has processed $4.88M in cryptographically verified purchase GMV across 92,710 receipts — a deterministic commerce dataset that probabilistic cookie-based targeting cannot replicate at any CPM.

Grocery-supermarkets (1,451 receipts, $64K GMV) and restaurants-dining (1,180 receipts, $37K GMV) lead the 14-day category mix, making this dataset most immediately actionable for CPG, food, and beverage brands running shopper marketing programs.

Walmart leads verified brand coverage at 337 receipts over 14 days, with Kroger, Costco, Safeway, and Aldi rounding out the top five — a mass-market grocery concentration that reflects actual mid-market household spend, not panel inference.

Three new brand-list entrants appeared between October 12–16 — McDonald's (QSR), Lowe's (home improvement), and H-E-B (Texas regional grocery) — indicating the network is broadening vertically and geographically beyond its initial footprint, though no new entrants have appeared across five consecutive snapshots since October 16.

Structural daily receipt volume runs 326–398 receipts per day with a confirmed late-UTC burst pattern each evening, suggesting a consumer base concentrated in North American time zones and large enough to support statistically meaningful category-level targeting signals.

insights.topic: Payout freeze recovery as network health indicator
insights.insight: A 7-day payout freeze (October 11–18) resolved cleanly, with confirmed payouts rising from 765 to 785 in the days following — a stress event that cleared without disrupting receipt throughput, which is the signal brand data buyers should track when evaluating infrastructure reliability.
